name: MCP for the Homelab — Companion Recipes

recipes.title: Read-Only Media Librarian
recipes.summary: The reference filesystem MCP server pointed at a media tree, mounted read-only, with no network.

environmentVariables.name: MEDIA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory on the Docker host to expose read-only as /media.

recipes.firstQuestion: What's the largest file in my media folder and did anything land there this week?
scopeNotes: :ro mount: the server physically cannot write.
network_mode: none: nothing to phone home to.

recipes.title: Docker Forensics
recipes.summary: docker-mcp scoped with ALLOW_LIST: the assistant sees and manages only the containers you name.

environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_LIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated container names the assistant may see. This is the security boundary.

recipes.firstQuestion: Which containers have restarted more than once this week, and why?
scopeNotes: The only recipe that mounts the Docker socket.
ALLOW_LIST is the boundary; unlisted containers are invisible.

recipes.title: Home Assistant Concierge
recipes.summary: Home Assistant over MCP, scoped to a dedicated houseguest-permission user.

upstream.description: Community Home Assistant MCP server (pin your choice)

environmentVariables.name: HASS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Home Assistant base URL.

environmentVariables.name: HASS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Long-lived access token for a DEDICATED, houseguest-scoped user.

recipes.firstQuestion: Run the movie scene and tell me what it actually changed.
scopeNotes: Dedicated HA user; never your personal token.
Locks, alarm panels and garage doors stay off the menu.

recipes.title: Proxmox Auditor
recipes.summary: Proxmox VE over MCP with a PVEAuditor-role API token.

upstream.description: Community Proxmox MCP server (pin your choice)

environmentVariables.name: PVE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Proxmox VE API URL.

environmentVariables.name: PVE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token with the PVEAuditor role (user@realm!tokenid=secret).

environmentVariables.name: VERIFY_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Verify the PVE certificate. Prefer installing your CA over disabling.

recipes.firstQuestion: Which VMs haven't been touched in 90 days and how much RAM are they hoarding?
scopeNotes: PVEAuditor role only for week one.
Promote write capability deliberately, with a menu-notes entry.

recipes.title: qBittorrent Night Manager
recipes.summary: qBittorrent over MCP for 2 a.m. diagnostics, on qBit's network only.

upstream.description: Community qBittorrent MCP server (pin your choice)

environmentVariables.name: QBIT_URL
environmentVariables.description: qBittorrent WebUI URL.

environmentVariables.name: QBIT_USER
environmentVariables.description: DEDICATED qBit account for the assistant.

environmentVariables.name: QBIT_PASS
environmentVariables.description: Password for the dedicated account.

recipes.firstQuestion: Why is nothing downloading — check the queue and any stalled transfers.
scopeNotes: Dedicated qBit account: the account is the scope.
Network-exiled to qBit's segment.

recipes.title: Radarr Butler (the *arr pattern)
recipes.summary: Radarr over MCP, and the template for Sonarr, Prowlarr and Lidarr.

environmentVariables.name: ARR_URL
environmentVariables.description: Radarr base URL.

environmentVariables.name: ARR_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Radarr API key (Settings → General → Security).

recipes.firstQuestion: What's sitting in Radarr's queue, and what's been stuck longest?
scopeNotes: Read-only until the couch-grab day.
One server per *arr app; never share.

recipes.title: Pi-hole Query Detective
recipes.summary: Pi-hole over MCP with a read-only token.

upstream.description: Community Pi-hole MCP server (pin a release matching your Pi-hole major version)

environmentVariables.name: PIHOLE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Pi-hole URL.

environmentVariables.name: PIHOLE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Read-only scoped token / app password.

recipes.firstQuestion: Which client made the most blocked queries in the last 24 hours?
scopeNotes: Read-only token.
'Disable blocking' stays behind the approval click forever.

recipes.title: NAS Health Warden
recipes.summary: TrueNAS SCALE over MCP: pool health, disk temps, dataset usage. Read-only, full stop.

upstream.description: Community TrueNAS MCP server (pin your choice)

environmentVariables.name: TN_URL
environmentVariables.description: TrueNAS websocket URL.

environmentVariables.name: TN_KEY
environmentVariables.description: READ-ONLY API key for a dedicated user.

recipes.firstQuestion: How is the pool, and is any disk running hotter than its siblings?
scopeNotes: Read-only API key, full stop.
Dedicated user under Credentials → Users.

recipes.title: Grafana Question Answerer
recipes.summary: Grafana over MCP with a Viewer-role service account: questions, not dashboards.

environmentVariables.name: GRAFANA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Grafana base URL.

environmentVariables.name: GRAFANA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Service-account token with the Viewer role.

recipes.firstQuestion: What does the last hour of CPU look like on the hypervisor, and does it correlate with anything else on that dashboard?
scopeNotes: Viewer role only.
Dashboards for graphs; MCP for questions.

recipes.title: The Custom Front Desk
recipes.summary: A complete FastMCP server wrapping a (mock) vendor API with two read-only tools. Read the source; it's the chapter.

environmentVariables.name: POOL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Vendor API base URL (defaults to the baked-in mock).

environmentVariables.name: POOL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Vendor API key; empty for the mock.

recipes.firstQuestion: Is the pool heater on, and how does the water temp compare to the solar intake reading?
scopeNotes: Two read-only tools; scope enforced in code.
Write tool ships commented out with a promotion checklist.
